newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gujing Distillery to list A shares.
newsitem.headline: Gujing Distillery to list A shares.

text.p: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd, which has B shares listed in Shenzhen, has been allowed by the exchange to list 18 million class A shares on Sept 27, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The A shares were issued at 8.48 yuan per share earlier this month, the spokesman said.
The firm also offered two million shares to staff members at the same price. The shares will not be listed until six months after their issue in line with securities rules, he said.
Gujing now has a total of 235 million outstanding shares, including 155 million state shares and 60 million B shares, which were listed in Shenzhen in June with an issue price of HK$3.64 per share.
The company's A share prospectus said Gujing intended to use proceeds of the A issue issue, about 150 million yuan, to expand spirit production and finance an electric power project.
It forecast its after-tax profits at 165 million yuan this year, up from 145 million yuan in 1995 and 123 million yuan a year earlier, based the domestic accounting system.

The spokesman said that the company, based in the city of Bozhou in eastern China's Anhui province, has based profit growth targets on growing production of spirits with lower alcohol content, in line with changing consumer demand.
Gujing said in its interim report for 1996 that it chalked up after-tax profits of 65.36 million yuan on turnover of 695.08 million yuan in the first half.
The firm said that under Chinese accounting standards, earnings per share reached 0.62 yuan in the first half against a forecast target of 0.70 yuan per share for the whole of 1996.
